args.sql:
WITH msi AS (
  SELECT 
    market_sentiment_indicators::json AS data
  FROM analyticsindicators
),
flow_info AS (
  SELECT 
    json_extract_path_text(data, 'flow', 'smartforce') AS smart_trading_flow,
    json_extract_path_text(data, 'big_players', 'whalemotion') AS whale_driven_market_activity
  FROM msi
),
market_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    DISTINCT(json_extract_path_text(quote_depth_snapshot, 'metadata', 'mktcombo')) AS market_pair
  FROM marketdata
)

SELECT 
  flow_info.smart_trading_flow AS flow_category,
  flow_info.whale_driven_market_activity AS whale_driven_market_activity,
  market_pairs.market_pair AS market_pair,
  AVG(
    (marketstats.highspotday - marketstats.lowspotday) / marketstats.lowspotday
  ) OVER (
    PARTITION BY flow_info.smart_trading_flow, flow_info.whale_driven_market_activity, market_pairs.market_pair
  ) AS avg_price_change_1hr,
  AVG(
    (marketstats.highspotday - marketstats.lowspotday) / marketstats.lowspotday
  ) OVER (
    PARTITION BY flow_info.smart_trading_flow, flow_info.whale_driven_market_activity, market_pairs.market_pair
  ) AS avg_price_change_4hr,
  AVG(
    (marketstats.highspotday - marketstats.lowspotday) / marketstats.lowspotday
  ) OVER (
    PARTITION BY flow_info.smart_trading_flow, flow_info.whale_driven_market_activity, market_pairs.market_pair
  ) AS avg_price_change_24hr,
  SUM(
    CASE 
      WHEN (marketstats.highspotday - marketstats.lowspotday) / marketstats.lowspotday > 0 
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) OVER (
    PARTITION BY flow_info.smart_trading_flow, flow_info.whale_driven_market_activity, market_pairs.market_pair
  ) * 100 / COUNT(*) OVER (
    PARTITION BY flow_info.smart_trading_flow, flow_info.whale_driven_market_activity, market_pairs.market_pair
  ) AS smart_trading_success_rate
FROM 
  flow_info
CROSS JOIN market_pairs
LEFT JOIN marketdata ON 1 = 1
LEFT JOIN marketstats ON marketdata.marketdatanode = marketstats.mdlink
GROUP BY 
  flow_info.smart_trading_flow,
  flow_info.whale_driven_market_activity,
  market_pairs.market_pair
ORDER BY 
  smart_trading_success_rate DESC;

  FROM msi
),
market_pairs AS (
  SELECT

)

SELECT 
  flow_info.smart_trading_flow AS flow_category,
  flow_info.whale_driven_market_activity AS whale_driven_market_activity,
  market_pairs.market_pair AS market_pair,

  AVG(
    (marketstats.highspotday - marketstats.lowspotday) / marketstats.lowspotday

  ) AS avg_price_change_4hr,

    (marketstats.highspotday - marketstats.lowspotday) / marketstats.lowspotday
  ) OVER (
    PARTITION BY flow_info.smart_trading_flow, flow_info.whale_driven_market_activity, market_pairs.market_pair
  ) AS avg_price_change_24hr,
  SUM(
    CASE 
      WHEN (marketstats.highspotday - marketstats.lowspotday) / marketstats.lowspotday > 0

  flow_info
CROSS JOIN market_pairs

LEFT JOIN marketstats ON marketdata.marketdatanode = marketstats.mdlink
GROUP BY 
  flow_info.smart_trading_flow,
  flow_info.whale_driven_market_activity,
  market_pairs.market_pair
ORDER BY 
  smart_trading_success_rate DESC;
